feature.name: Delete tutorial from student view
feature.objective: Allow a user to delete an individual tutorial from the student view after reviewing the populated data applicable to that tutorial's type.

included: A Delete button for each tutorial in the student view.
A read-only confirmation dialog before deletion.
Type-aware display of the tutorial's existing data.
Mandatory display of tutorial type and Date of tutorial.
Omission of all empty fields and empty sections.
Hover and keyboard-accessible full-text overlays for truncated long comments.
Dedicated frontend and backend deletion flow.
excluded: Displaying fields that are not applicable to the tutorial type.
Editing tutorial data from the delete confirmation dialog.
Deleting a tutorial merely by removing its row from the frontend.

button_behaviour.click: Start the tutorial deletion confirmation flow.
must_not: Modify tutorial data before deletion is confirmed.

busy_state.during_deletion: The Delete control for the tutorial being deleted is disabled while the deletion request is in progress.

steps.action: User clicks Delete for a tutorial.
Application identifies the selected tutorial and resolves the complete existing tutorial data required for confirmation.
Application determines the authoritative tutorial type.
Application projects the existing data according to the semantic contract for that tutorial type.
Application removes empty fields and empty sections from the confirmation view.
Read-only delete confirmation dialog is displayed.
User either cancels or explicitly confirms deletion.
On confirmation, the dedicated tutorial deletion operation is performed.
On successful deletion, tutorial data is refreshed and archive/source presence is reconciled.

confirmation_dialog.purpose: Allow the user to review the actual populated data for the selected tutorial before permanently deleting it.
confirmation_dialog.title: Delete tutorial

layout.scrolling: Enabled only when the populated content exceeds the available dialog height.
layout.short_scalar_fields: Dense grids or compact metadata rows.
layout.comparison_data: Compact comparison grid where the tutorial type contains related initial and final values.
layout.long_text: Compact allocated display area with overflow handling.
must_not: Use a long single-column form for all fields.

tutorial_type.reason: Identifies the tutorial category being deleted.

date_of_tutorial.reason: Essential tutorial identity and deletion confirmation context.

footer.warning: This tutorial will be permanently deleted.

actions.label: Cancel
actions.effect: Close the dialog and perform no deletion.

field_visibility_policy.principle: Display only populated fields that are applicable to the selected tutorial type.

date_of_tutorial_exception.rule: Date of tutorial is essential confirmation context and must always be displayed as part of tutorial identity.

layout.identity: Compact header containing tutorial type and Date of tutorial.
layout.common_fields: Compact metadata row or dense grid.
layout.current_levels: Dense multi-column grid containing only populated values.
layout.assessment: Dense multi-column grid containing only populated values.
layout.long_text_fields: Full-width compact sections only when populated.

layout.identity: Compact header containing tutorial type and Date of tutorial.
layout.common_fields: Compact metadata row or dense grid containing only populated values.
layout.initial_levels: Dense multi-column grid containing only populated values.
layout.course_fields: Compact value display only when populated.

historical_data_policy.rule: Do not automatically display preserved historical fields that are outside the normal Initial tutorial semantic contract.
historical_data_policy.reason: The delete confirmation dialog displays the applicable semantic fields for the tutorial type rather than every possible stored historical field.

level_comparison.layout: Compact Initial versus Final comparison grid.
level_comparison.row_visibility_rule: Display a comparison row only when at least one applicable value in that row is populated.

layout.identity: Compact header containing tutorial type and Date of tutorial.
layout.common_fields: Compact metadata row or dense grid containing only populated values.
layout.levels: Compact Initial versus Final comparison grid.
layout.long_text_fields: Full-width compact sections only when populated.

content_that_fits.display: Show normally within the allocated compact area.

content_that_does_not_fit.display: Show truncated content within the allocated compact area.

overlay.layering: Appear above the surrounding dialog content and other fields.
overlay.layout_effect: Must not reflow, resize, or permanently expand the dialog.
dismissal: Mouse leaves the relevant interaction area.
Keyboard focus leaves the relevant interaction area.

long_text_overflow.space_saving_rule: Long comments must not permanently occupy additional dialog space solely because their full content is longer than the compact display area.

data_rules.projection_rule: Interpret and display the record according to the existing semantic contract for the authoritative tutorial type.
data_rules.display_scope: Only fields applicable to the tutorial type.
data_rules.displayed_field_rule: Only populated applicable fields are displayed.
data_rules.authoritative_identity: Deletion must be based on authoritative tutorial identity rather than abbreviated row data alone.

state_data.complete_tutorial_details: Existing tutorial data used by the confirmation dialog.
state_data.delete_error: Failure information when deletion does not succeed.

steps: Complete the authoritative tutorial deletion operation.
Refresh or reconcile the student's tutorial list.
Ensure the deleted tutorial is no longer displayed as an active source tutorial.
Do not incorrectly remove the tutorial from the student view.
Clear or restore transient deletion state as appropriate.
Return the interface to a stable state.

student_overview.change: Add an Actions column or equivalent per-row control containing the Delete button.
student_overview.event_isolation: Delete interaction must stop propagation to revision-opening row interactions.

api_layer.change: Add a narrowly scoped typed delete tutorial operation.
api_layer.principle: Do not expose a generic arbitrary mutation mechanism.

responsibilities: Render tutorial type and Date of tutorial.
Project fields according to tutorial type.
Use dense grids for compact scalar data.

requirements: Authenticate and validate the active session.
Resolve the authoritative tutorial record where required.
Reject invalid or ambiguous tutorial identities.
Perform only the specific tutorial deletion operation.
Return a typed success or failure result.
Refresh or reconcile local archive state after successful deletion.
must_not: Accept deletion authority solely from abbreviated student-view row content.
Implement deletion solely as a frontend row removal.
Expose an unrestricted generic mutation endpoint.

archive_consistency.principle: Deleting a live tutorial must preserve the application's existing archive and source-presence semantics.
post_delete_sequence: Apply the existing archive and source-presence model.
Update the student view from reconciled data.

reject: Deletion requests that cannot establish the required authoritative target.
safety_requirements.confirmation: Deletion requires explicit user confirmation after the type-aware data review dialog has been displayed.

implementation_order.task: Define the type-aware confirmation data projection using the existing tutorial semantic contracts.
Implement complete tutorial detail resolution for the selected tutorial when the student list does not already contain all required populated data.
Implement reusable field filtering so empty fields and empty sections are omitted.
Implement the compact read-only confirmation dialog with mandatory tutorial type and Date of tutorial.
Implement dense scalar grids and the Final Initial-versus-Final comparison layout.
Implement compact long-text display and full-content overlay behaviour.
Add the Delete button to each tutorial row without interfering with revision behaviour.
Add the narrowly scoped frontend deletion API operation.
Implement the dedicated backend deletion command and validation.
Implement post-delete refresh and archive reconciliation.
Update capability contracts and safety rules that currently prohibit tutorial deletion.
Add frontend, backend, and end-to-end tests.
